name: Multi-Entity Finance Leader
description: CFO or controller running finance for a company with multiple entities, subsidiaries, or locations who needs one consolidated view instead of stitching together spreadsheets. Often in financial services, nonprofit, or complex mid-market organizations.
priorities: AI-driven forecasting and cash flow visibility

name: QuickBooks Upgrader
description: Finance lead who has outgrown QuickBooks Online or Desktop and is evaluating an ERP step-up, wanting a fast, low-disruption migration rather than a rebuild. Often in services, construction, or growing SMBs.
priorities: keep existing Chart of Accounts and lists
AI automation to reduce manual work

name: Construction & Field Services Controller
description: Controller at a project-based construction, field-services, or trades business weighing Intuit Enterprise Suite against other mid-market ERPs. Needs real-time job costing, WIP visibility, and AIA billing without months of implementation.

name: Accountant / ProAdvisor
description: Accounting firm or ProAdvisor helping clients evaluate and migrate to Intuit Enterprise Suite, motivated by preferred pricing, referral bonuses, and hands-on migration support. Manages complex multi-entity clients across industries.
priorities: professional services support for client migrations
tools that save time on journal entries and reconciliations
an open ecosystem of apps clients already use

name: Nonprofit & Professional Services Finance Director
description: Finance director at a nonprofit or professional-services organization managing multiple locations, grants, programs, or project-based contracts. Prioritizes governance, compliance, and audit-readiness.
priorities: audit-ready controls and complete approval history
consolidated reporting across programs or locations

name: George — Buying Group Influencer (RTCDP test)
description: Test persona for the RTCDP/AJO buying-group demo: resolves to George's AEP sandbox profile (Buying Group Member Role is Influencer, Job Title is IT Security) so applying it makes the page's Alloy adopt that identity and surface the real segment membership.
priorities: evaluate fit for the buying group
